task: Estimate burned forest area in the Montesinho park from recorded weather and fire-index conditions.
context: X/Y: park map grid coordinates; month/day: calendar categories without full event date; FFMC/DMC/DC/ISI: fire-weather indices; temp: Celsius; RH: percent; wind: km/h; rain: mm/m^2 as described in the source. The target is untransformed hectares, including zero. Event timing is incomplete, so this is retrospective conditional estimation.
